Create a square high-resolution 2500x2500 raster contact sheet with EXACTLY 5 columns and 5 rows, equal cells, perfectly aligned edge-to-edge, NO gutters, NO borders, NO labels/text. Each cell must be ONE genuine-looking, fully integrated photograph with its own natural setting, not a pasted cutout or cartoon. FIVE ROWS correspond to five named subjects below. FIVE COLUMNS are five DIFFERENT real examples of that SAME row's named object: vary actual object appearance, size, color, viewpoint and suitable surroundings, still immediately recognizable as same noun.
Lighting: realistic soft daylight, matched contact shadows, physical grounding, camera perspective and material textures. Target fills 55-75% of each cell, whole target inside central 80%, keep target unobscured, clear and child-friendly. Minimal soft-focus context, no competing recognizable objects, no people, no words, no logos, no watermark. Never white rectangular object cards or glowing artificial silhouettes. Real photo textures, never clay/3D toy rendering (except actual toy subjects). Background and object form ONE photograph.
